notes.title: Patch Note – Prologue v0.2a Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Bazaar Folks![/h3][p]We’re back with a fresh update for the [b]Prologue version[/b]!
This patch strengthens the core systems, enhances visuals, and finally introduces one of the most anticipated features: [b]Multiplayer mode[/b]! 🎮🌐[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Multiplayer Mode[/h3][p]You can now build your market with friends, make sales together, and complete tasks as a team![/p][hr][/hr][h3]💡 Graphics & Lighting Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]The in-game lighting system has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Ambient lighting is now more natural and warm.[/p][/*][*][p]Sunrises, sunsets, and the day-night cycle are more realistic than ever.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌿 Environmental Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Natural elements on the map (trees, ground textures, shadows) are now more detailed.[/p][/*][*][p]The market area feels more atmospheric and vibrant.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some crashes occurring during game startup.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved bugs that caused certain tasks to get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual glitches and UI inconsistencies have been addressed.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🎮 A smoother experience for new players and a much more fun market adventure with multiplayer support await you![/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you and happy selling! 💰🧺[/p]

notes.title: Fish Products, Digital Scale and Bug Fixes Update
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Hello Everyone ![/h2][/b]

Thank you for playing Bazaar Simulator Prologue.

Below are the fixes and new features that come with our first major patch:

[h3]New Features Added:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fish Products:You can now sell fish in the market. Add different types of fish to your stall to offer to your customers.
[*] Scale Mechanic: The mechanic for purchasing and placing scales has been added to the game. You can add a scale to your stall and change its position at any time.
[*] Digital Scale: A digital scale has been added to the game for precise measurements. This allows you to weigh your products more accurately.
[*] Environment and Lighting Adjustments: Environmental improvements and enhanced lighting have been made in the game world, creating a more impressive market atmosphere.
[/list]

[h3]Fixed Issues:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Translation Errors: Translation errors in Korean, Chinese, and Japanese languages have been corrected. Other translation errors in various languages have also been fixed.
[*] Resolution Issues: The issue where buttons could not be clicked when changing resolution has been resolved. You can now enjoy a seamless gaming experience at different resolutions.
[*] Price Update Bug: The issue where prices did not update after closing and reopening the game has been fixed.
[*] Scale Bowl Bug: The bug that prevented the scale bowl from being picked up has been resolved. Scale bowls now work smoothly.
[*] Level System and Economy Balance: The level system and in-game economy have been balanced. The game flow is now more balanced.
[*] Price Calculation Updates: Updates have been made to the price calculation area, allowing you to manage prices more accurately.
[*] Stall Placement Issues: Issues caused by placing stalls too close together have been resolved.
[*] End of Day and Payment Issues: Problems such as end-of-day errors and incorrect payments after customer orders have been fixed.
[*] Money Box Issues: Problems encountered when clicking on the money box have been resolved. Money transactions now work smoothly.
[*] Bagging Bug: The bug causing the game to freeze when clicking on another bag while holding a bag has been fixed.
[*] whosale market Section Issues: The issue where money was not received when products were taken in the wholesale marketsection has been resolved.
[*] Visual and Cosmetic Improvements: In-game visual enhancements and cosmetic changes have been made.
[*] Product Transfer Bug: The issue where products fell off the stall when transferring from the bag back to the bowl has been fixed.
[*] Market Product Issues: The bug that prevented products from being deleted or increased in certain situations in the market has been resolved.
[*] Tutorial Improvements: Improvements have been made to the tutorial section of the game.
[*] Character Clipping Issue: The issue of the character getting stuck when transferring products to the bag has been resolved.
[*] Product Save Bug: The bug causing purchased products not to be saved in certain situations has been fixed.
[*] Start Day Issue: The situation where it was unclear that you needed to go to the scale to start the day has been addressed.
[/list]

Please report any issues you encounter during the game on our Discord channel so we can produce solutions as soon as possible!
